question: Which source blank lines belong in canonical formatter output?
decision: Retain at most one blank line between top-level syntax items when the source gap contains at least two line breaks; normalize leading/trailing blank lines and blank lines inside nested delimiters.

layout.top_level_blank_lines: at most one source blank line between syntax items
layout.nested_blank_lines: normalize using the existing delimiter layout
layout.comments: preserve exact text and source order; adjacent top-level blank gaps are retained

quantitative_gate: Formatter C++ and CLI suites pass; the 235-case corpus remains parseable, idempotent, comment-stable, and AST/semantic-parity equivalent where applicable.
